question_text: Was the European Commission hit by a cyberattack?
answer_text: Yes, by its own account. The Commission says it was hit by a cyberattack using AI tools, first detected on Oct 22, and that an incident on its EU Academy learning platform involves users' personal data.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Was my EU Academy data stolen?
what_would_settle_it: The Commission saying how many users and which data were affected, or contacting them.

question_text: Who was behind the attack on the European Commission?
what_would_settle_it: The Commission or CERT-EU naming the attacker once the investigation ends.

question_text: When will EU Academy be back?
what_would_settle_it: The Commission saying when access returns and whether the Jan 14 reopening is linked to the attack.

answer_text: Not as far as anyone has shown. The Commission says investigators found no evidence of a data breach affecting its staff broadly.
label: Reported
